Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: Matrix cracking of 2D SiC/SiC composite characterized by in situ SEM and nano-CT

Composition_Info.Alloy_Name_Raw: 2D plain-woven SiC fiber-reinforced SiC matrix composite with BN interphase
Composition_Info.Note: SiC matrix presents non-uniform distribution with SiC blocks, C-rich layer and O-rich regions; SiC fiber diameter 12.2 μm, density 3.1 g·cm⁻³

Process_Text.original: 2D preform formed by alternately stacking four plain SiC fiber layers; tightened between two graphite plates to ensure thickness 1.3 mm; seamed with carbon fibers to keep fiber volume fraction ~40%; BN interface deposited at ~800-1000 °C from BCl₃-NH₃-H₂-Ar systems by CVI; vacuum impregnation with liquid polycarbosilane (PCS) dissolved in xylene (mass ratio 1:1); pyrolyzed at 900 °C for 1 h in argon atmosphere; repeated until weight gain in one cycle < 1%
Process_Text.simplified: 2D SiC fiber preform stacked and seamed; BN interphase deposited via CVI at 800-1000 °C; PIP process with PCS/xylene impregnation and 900 °C pyrolysis in Ar, cycled to density

Process_Info.Equipment: Zeiss Gemini 500 SEM, Zeiss Xradia 520 versa nano-CT, Zeiss sigma 300 SEM

Microstructure_Text.original: Plain-woven structure with square pores; PIP-SiC matrix has non-homogeneous distribution with bright white SiC blocks, dark gray network-like O-rich structures, shrinkage cracks and pores; interlayer pores and closed pores within fiber bundles as internal defects; intra-bundle micropores of tens of nanometers; weak BN interface between fiber and matrix
Microstructure_Text.simplified: 2D plain-woven SiC/SiC with porous structure; PIP-SiC matrix is inhomogeneous with SiC blocks, shrinkage cracks, pores and O-rich regions; BN weak interface exists; micro/nano pores distributed in bundles and interlayers
